cases.name: Kelly Marie James Zummo
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "After high school, she headed north and graduated from West Virginia University with a Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering (1995) and Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering (1997). Kelly began her career with a short assignment at the NASA Langley Research Center, Hampton, VA, where she continued her graduate thesis research. In March of 1998, Kelly seized the opportunity to return to the hills of West Virginia to embark on her long and successful aerospace/aviation career that culminated as Engineering Manager and Chief Engineer at Pratt & Whitney Engine Services (PWES) located in Bridgeport, WV. During her tenure at PWES, she held several lead titles and worked with the PWES division out of Hartford, Connecticut, and the parent company out of Montreal, Canada. She trained many new engineers, supervisors and shop leads.

Perhaps one of Kelly’s greatest contributions was to the children and young adults of the North Central WV region. She attended numerous schools and educations fairs, speaking to children about STEM education and careers in aerospace/aviation. She toured hundreds of children and adults through the workplace. Kelly’s connections with the local high schools were highly instrumental in the recent formation of Harrison County’s Aerospace Aviation Program. Her generosity and grace were especially bright during Christmas season with her involvement with the annual Angel Tree and the Children’s Christmas Party.

Outside of work, Kelly was a sports mom and enjoyed watching her sons play basketball. She loved to watch the Atlanta Braves play on television. The beach was her happy place and she often vacationed at Myrtle Beach, SC. Kelly loved antiques. She was a member of Simpson Creek Baptist Church in Bridgeport. She had a positive personality and was helpful to others.
cases.narrative: She fled in a vehicle after he shot her and struck a house.
